verses.text: They brought God's ark inside and set it in the middle of the tent David had pitched for it. Then they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
When David had finished presenting the burnt offerings and peace offerings, he blessed the people in the LORD's name.
He gave every Israelite, men and women alike, a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a raisin cake.
David appointed some of the Levites to serve before the LORD's ark, to remember his deeds and give thanks and praise to the LORD, the God of Israel.
Asaph was in charge, with Zechariah second. Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel played stringed instruments and harps, and Asaph sounded the cymbals.
The priests Benaiah and Jahaziel regularly blew trumpets before the ark of God's covenant.
That day David first appointed Asaph and his relatives to give thanks to the LORD:
Give thanks to the LORD and call on his name. Tell the peoples what he's done.
Sing to him, sing his praises, and speak of all his wonderful works.
Take pride in his holy name. Let everyone who seeks the LORD rejoice from the heart.
Seek the LORD and his strength. Keep seeking his face always.
Remember the wonders he's done, his miracles and the judgments he's spoken,
you descendants of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen people.
He is the LORD our God. His judgments reach throughout the earth.
Remember his covenant forever, the promise he commanded for a thousand generations,
the covenant he made with Abraham and the oath he swore to Isaac.
He confirmed it as a statute for Jacob, an everlasting covenant for Israel.
He said, “I'll give you the land of Canaan as your allotted inheritance,”
when you were very few and lived there as foreigners.
They traveled from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.
He let no one harm them. He even rebuked kings for their sake:
“Don't touch my anointed ones, and do my prophets no harm!”
Sing to the LORD, all the earth! Tell of his saving work day after day.
Declare his glory among the nations and his wonderful works among all peoples.
The LORD is great and deserves great praise. He is to be held in awe above all gods.
All the gods of the peoples are idols. The LORD made the heavens.
Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and joy are where he dwells.
Give the LORD his due, families of the peoples. Give the LORD glory and strength!
Give the LORD the glory his name deserves. Bring an offering and come before him. Worship the LORD in holy splendor.
Tremble before him, all the earth. The world stands firm and can't be moved.
Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice. Let people say among the nations, “The LORD reigns!”
Let the sea and everything in it roar. Let the fields and all they hold be glad.
Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, because he's coming to judge the earth.
Give thanks to the LORD, because he is good. His faithful love lasts forever.
Say, “Save us, God our savior. Gather us and rescue us from the nations, so we can thank your holy name and rejoice in your praise.”
Praise the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting! All the people said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD.
David left Asaph and his relatives there before the ark of the LORD's covenant to serve before it regularly, doing whatever each day required.
Obed-Edom and their sixty-eight relatives stayed as well. Obed-Edom son of Jeduthun and Hosah were gatekeepers.
David left Zadok the priest and his fellow priests in front of the LORD's sanctuary at the high place in Gibeon.
They were to offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offerings every morning and evening, in keeping with everything written in the LORD's law that he had given Israel.
Heman, Jeduthun, and the others chosen by name were with them to give thanks to the LORD, because his faithful love lasts forever.
Heman and Jeduthun were there with trumpets and cymbals to sound aloud and instruments for songs to God. Jeduthun's sons were assigned to the gate.
Then everyone went home, and David went back to bless his household.
